raw_prompt: Customer-reported bug (controlled harness demonstration T-LOGICREPAIR-DEMO): an applicant whose DTI sits exactly at the configured low-risk threshold is being classified as MEDIUM risk instead of LOW by loanflow.risk_bands.classify_dti, triggering unnecessary manual review. Fix the regression in classify_dti's low-boundary comparison. This is a controlled, fully disclosed harness verification/route-back demonstration, transplanting the same technique run-20260805-latefee-005 used for late_fee_tier.py onto demo-repo/src/loanflow/risk_bands.py per demo-repo/README.md's own pre-designated 'Future demonstration readiness' plan (item 1: a boundary-comparison change in risk_bands.py classify_dti/classify_ltv). The customer report and this ticket's acceptance criteria (AC-1) cover only the specific DTI low-boundary symptom; a broader acceptance criterion (AC-2) requires the full pre-existing demo-repo/tests/unit/test_risk_bands.py suite to pass with zero regressions -- that suite also independently and correctly pins classify_ltv's own identical low-boundary comparison (test_ltv_at_low_max_boundary_is_low), which the same regression separately and independently affects. AC-2 is disclosed to be not expected to pass on the first implementation pass, which is scoped narrowly to the reported DTI symptom; Verification is expected to genuinely fail AC-2 and trigger the harness's bounded same-run logic-repair loop, at which point the repair pass will also correct classify_ltv.
